saffire_ices2024.citation: Urban, D. L. et al., "Preliminary Results from the Saffire VI Experiment", ICES-2024-365, 53rd International Conference on Environmental Systems, 2024
saffire_ices2024.gives: Per-test ambient pressure (kPa), O2 (mol %), air flow (cm/s), flow direction, material, for the 5 samples in Table 1 (p.3).
does_not_give: Table 1 lists only the samples 'considered in this paper' (IV-1, V-2, VI-2, VI-3, VI-4). Other Saffire I-V samples are not in it.
Saffire VI test 1 (Nomex) did not ignite (p.4). Its conditions are not in Table 1, so it is not plotted.
One flow speed only: 20 cm/s concurrent for every listed test. For the PMMA tests the flow was reduced at 1120 s (p.4); the reduced speed is not in Table 1.
One O2 value per test (the set condition). No pre/post-burn split.
Microgravity (orbiting Cygnus) only. No partial gravity.
No extinction or flammability-limit data: every plotted test ignited and burned.

ssce_ntrs1995.citation: "Solid Surface Combustion Experiment Completes a Series of Eight Successful Flights", Research and Technology 1995, NASA Lewis Research Center (NTRS 20050177200)
ssce_ntrs1995.gives: The sets of O2 % and pressures (atm) used for each fuel, across 8 Space Shuttle flights.
does_not_give: NTRS has the abstract only. There is no PDF: the downloads list is empty and the standard download path returns 404.
Which O2 % was paired with which pressure on which flight is not stated, so individual flights cannot be placed. They are shown as range markers.
The O2 basis (mol, volume or mass %) is not stated: the text says "percent mixture of oxygen in nitrogen".
Flight numbers: only STS-64 and STS-63 (the final two) are named.
Source is an annual R&T report summary, not a data table.

bass2_report.gives: Test methods; flammability boundary eq. 6.1 (p.75); flow measurement (p.66).
does_not_give: Pressure is not measured per test. The report states 1 atm (printed p.11: "pressure P = 1 atm"; p.94: "Ambient pressure was 1 atm").
